distinguishes: The transactions exp-frames experiment 48 sent to the Hegota testnet, read under the bound template claim-gated names, with each paymaster's code as the testnet serves it: two bound spends the testnet mined are bound and valid; the three copies of the bound withdrawal it refused are not bound, or bound to a key the ticket does not name and so not valid; and the version 5 control, whose copy with raised fees the testnet mined in its original's place, carries no binder and is not bound. A node that reads the bound template's frame as a version 5 ticket, or that finds the binder only at index 0, fails here.
source: exp-frames branch exp/48-bound-ticket at 9a6427f, experiments/48-bound-ticket/record.json (every transaction's bytes and the testnet's answers); the code of 0xca7aa9eb83846186c1562abab968d1568ad55228 and 0x4687b01b7e3642144e1386a8c128bd16a8c722a9 by eth_getCode at block 493609, and the receipts of 0xf3a3e70e..., 0x266284a1... and 0x2b193135... (blocks 491574, 491578 and 491576) by eth_getTransactionReceipt, 2026-10-21. Each claim's validity was checked with Commonware at c18a6b9 and each binding with viem's recovery before the vectors were written.

cases.name: experiment 48: a fresh sender's bound spend, mined in block 491574
cases.derivation: Its paymaster's code is the bound template, the committee's key and its denomination, so its 188 bytes carry a binder; the sender signed first and the binder second, so the binder's entry is at index 1 (CG-12 reads every entry). Mined as 0xf3a3e70e....

cases.name: experiment 48: a fresh sender's version 5 spend, mined in block 491572
cases.derivation: Its paymaster is the version 5 template, so the claim has no binder and is not bound (CG-12), though the ticket verifies. Mined as 0xfda8fd18...; under claim-gated a node refuses it (ErrClaimUnbound).

cases.name: experiment 48: the pool's bound withdrawal, mined in block 491578
cases.derivation: The pool is its own sender and signs nothing; the only signature is the binder's, over the signature hash. Mined as 0x266284a1....

cases.name: experiment 48: its copy with raised fees and the binder's signature kept
cases.derivation: The fees are inside the signature hash, so the binder's signature no longer recovers the binder. The testnet refused it before any frame ran: "frame signature list does not authenticate the sender".

cases.name: experiment 48: its copy with the binder's entry removed
cases.derivation: No entry resolves to the binder (CG-12 step 2). The testnet refused it: "validation prefix frame reverted", the template finding no entry.

cases.name: experiment 48: its copy naming another binder, which signed it
cases.derivation: The copier put its own key's address in the frame's data and signed the signature hash with it, so the claim is bound to the copier; but the committee signed the message with the buyer's binder, so the ticket does not verify (CG-9) and CG-2 step 2 refuses it. The testnet refused it: "validation prefix frame reverted", the pairing failing.

cases.name: experiment 48: the control's withdrawal, a version 5 ticket
cases.derivation: The version 5 template: no binder, not bound. Admitted on the testnet, then replaced by the copy below.

cases.name: experiment 48: the control's copy with raised fees, signed by no one, mined in block 491576
cases.derivation: The copy that the testnet mined in its original's place: a version 5 ticket names only the slot, so the copy's ticket verifies as the original's did. It is not bound, so under claim-gated a node refuses it (ErrClaimUnbound), and so does the original. Mined as 0x2b193135....
